entities.summary: Andriy Yosypovych Bohdan is a Ukrainian lawyer and former Head of the Presidential Administration. On 21 May 2019, President Volodymyr Zelensky appointed Bohdan to lead the office. He was responsible for communication, as well as legal and political issues. Zelensky dismissed him on 11 February 2020. Previously, he was also the personal lawyer of oligarch Ihor Kolomoisky.
